sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "tracks"."media_type_id" AS e, AVG((CAST("tracks"."bytes" AS REAL) / "tracks"."milliseconds")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "tracks" GROUP BY "tracks"."media_type_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3"
